svg.title: Six rules for writing system-prompt rules
svg.desc: A hand-drawn grid of six cards. One concept per rule: rules joined by "and" hide partial compliance, so a combined refund-and-citation rule becomes two rules on two lines. Motivated by failure: add a rule when a real interaction went wrong, never because a hypothetical one might, and carry the date and issue id that motivated it. Positive over negative: "reply in formal English" instead of "do not be casual", because the negative form leaves a wide space of acceptable behaviour. Specific over vague: "limit replies to two hundred words" instead of "be concise", because only the specific form is auditable. Examples beat instructions: for a complex output format one good-and-bad pair routinely replaces a paragraph of rules. Reviewed like code: every change is a diff with a reviewer and a one-sentence justification in the commit message.
